learningObjectives: Understand how this course is organized: 8 lessons, each with a video, a See-and-Try, exercise(s), a solution video, and a final quiz.
Confirm the same 3 prerequisites from AS1 are still active: Tosca On-Premises, a valid license, and the Automation Extension in Chrome.
Know the pass mark and attempt rules for the AS2 final exam before you start.
Understand what you actually earn at the end — a Badge with points, same as AS1, not a Certificate.

elements.text: AS2 ("Optimizing Test Automation with Centralized Test Data") builds directly on AS1. Instead of building one TestCase at a time, you'll learn to centralize test data in TestSheets and turn a single TestCase into a Template that generates many TestCases at once.

elements.term: Each of the 8 lessons follows the same pattern
elements.description: Designed so you can move through the course quickly and predictably:
items: A video tutorial covering the key concepts
A See and Try section to practice the steps yourself
One or more exercises for hands-on practice
A solution video demonstrating the step-by-step process
A short quiz (most lessons) to check your understanding

elements.title: Recommended approach per lesson
items: Watch the video lesson to understand the topic.
Complete the exercise(s) yourself before watching the solution.
Review the solution video to compare your approach.
Once all 8 lessons are done, take the Final Exam.

elements.title: Supplementary resources bundled with the course
items: A full course Transcript (PDF) for quick review — see Section 10 of this track
A downloadable AS2 Exercise Workbook (PDF) and Tosca subset files (.tsu) per lesson
The Grand Scenario — a comprehensive final exercise consolidating everything (Section 9 of this track)
The same System Under Test (SUT) as AS1: the Tricentis Demo Web Shop

bulletPoints: SUT: https://demowebshop.tricentis.com — identical to AS1, no new environment to set up.
This content was developed using Tosca 12.0. Minor UI differences are possible in other versions.

elements.description: If you already completed AS1 in this same environment, you're ready — AS2 reuses the exact same setup.
items: Tricentis Tosca On-Premises installed (Windows, or Windows VM on macOS)
A valid Tosca license, active in Tosca Commander
Tricentis Automation Extension installed and enabled in Chrome

elements.text: If you're starting fresh with AS2 and skipped AS1, see Section 0 of the AS1 track in this app for full installation steps (Tosca install, license request, Chrome extension, and the macOS Windows-VM workaround).

elements.term: Tosca keeps showing a license pop-up on launch?
elements.description: This usually means Tosca Commander isn't connected to a valid license source. If your organization uses a Cloud License Server, connect Tosca directly to it: access the license configuration, go to the Setup tab, select Change connection, choose Connect to Cloud hosted License Server, then sign in with your Tricentis Support Hub credentials (enable Use default proxy if your organization requires a proxy).

items.label: Connect to your cloud license server

bulletPoints: See Section 0 of the AS1 track in this app for the full step-by-step Cloud License Server connection walkthrough.

rows: 2 attempts, then an automatic 3rd and final attempt
Must wait 2 weeks before another attempt is granted
Review all course materials thoroughly before starting — it significantly increases your odds of passing first try

elements.text: Ensure you have selected an answer for every question before submitting the exam — there's no partial-completion save.

Same as AS1: finishing AS2 does not end with a formal certification exam. It ends with the final quiz described above, which earns you a Badge and points — not a Certificate. Tricentis reserves Certificates for its multi-course "Product Consultant" learning paths; AS2, like AS1, is one course inside the Tricentis Tosca Product Consultant path, not a path by itself. Badges appear on your Academy "Badges" page with a shareable verification link.

items.label: Tricentis Academy — Certifications and Badges (official Support Hub article)

examPitfalls.title: Assuming AS2 needs a fresh environment setup
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Learners re-install Tosca or re-request a license, assuming AS2 is a separate environment from AS1.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: AS2 reuses the exact same Tosca installation, license, Automation Extension, and SUT (demowebshop.tricentis.com) as AS1. No new setup is needed.

examPitfalls.title: Starting the exam without reviewing materials
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Candidates attempt the Final Exam immediately after watching videos, without reviewing the Transcript or redoing exercises.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: The exam has only 2 manual attempts before the automatic 3rd (final) one, and failing that means a mandatory 2-week wait. Review all course materials thoroughly first — the pass mark is 60%.

practiceQuiz.scenario: You completed AS1 in your current Tosca environment and are about to start AS2. What setup do you need to do first?

options.text: Install a second, separate copy of Tosca On-Premises for AS2.
Request a brand-new Tosca training license specific to AS2.
Set up a new System Under Test, since AS2 uses a different demo application.
Nothing — AS2 reuses the same Tosca installation, license, Automation Extension, and SUT as AS1.

practiceQuiz.hint: AS2 is a continuation of AS1 in the same environment.
practiceQuiz.rationale: AS2 reuses the exact same Tosca On-Premises installation, license, Automation Extension, and SUT (demowebshop.tricentis.com) that you set up for AS1. No new environment is required.

practiceQuiz.scenario: What is the structure of each of the 8 AS2 lessons?

options.text: A live webinar that must be attended at a scheduled time.
A written article followed directly by the final exam.
A video tutorial, a See-and-Try, one or more exercises, a solution video, and (for most lessons) a quiz.
Only a single long video with no hands-on practice.

practiceQuiz.hint: It's a structured, repeatable pattern designed for self-paced learning.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Each lesson follows: video tutorial → See and Try → exercise(s) → solution video → (for most lessons) a short quiz. This is explicitly laid out in the 'Welcome to the Course' lesson.

practiceQuiz.scenario: What is the pass mark for the AS2 Final Exam, and how many attempts do you get?

options.text: 80% pass mark; unlimited attempts.
There is no pass mark — the exam is only for feedback purposes.
60% pass mark; only 1 attempt total, no retakes.
60% pass mark; 2 attempts, then an automatic 3rd and final attempt.

practiceQuiz.hint: Same general format as most Tricentis Academy course exams.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The pass mark is 60%. You get 2 attempts, and if both fail you automatically receive a 3rd and final attempt. Failing that requires a mandatory 2-week wait before another attempt.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A learner completes AS2 and its final quiz. What do they receive, according to the Tricentis Academy certification program?

options.text: A formal Certificate, since AS2 is an advanced-level course.
Nothing, since AS2 is not tracked by the Academy.
A Badge and points on the Badges page — AS2 alone does not grant a Certificate.
Automatic enrollment as a certified Tricentis Tosca Product Consultant.

practiceQuiz.hint: Same rule as AS1 — Certificates are reserved for full multi-course paths.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Like AS1, AS2 is one course inside the larger Tricentis Tosca Product Consultant certification path. Completing AS2 alone earns a Badge and points, not a standalone Certificate.

practiceQuiz.scenario: What is the System Under Test (SUT) used in AS2?

options.text: A new banking demo application exclusive to AS2.
A locally installed desktop application.
Whichever application the learner's own company uses.
The same Tricentis Demo Web Shop used in AS1 (https://demowebshop.tricentis.com).

practiceQuiz.hint: No new environment setup is needed for AS2.
practiceQuiz.rationale: AS2 continues to use the same hosted Tricentis Demo Web Shop as AS1 — no local server or new SUT setup is required.
